summary: Align the pty pin with the source downstream builds already use

compatibility.detail: Default smalltalk builds move from pty b9d02f3 to 1ae8c187 (19 commits), which changes runtime behavior for terminal attachment in st3, stui and st-runtime: an attach resize now sends a single SIGWINCH and no longer sends the extra redraw nudge; wait_ready wakes differently on close and disconnect; registry listing reports effective and native roots and requires completeness per root; published terminal frames are immutable. Builds whose downstream flake already overrode pty to 1ae8c187 already run this code and see no change.

manual.detail: No manual action required; the aligned pins satisfy the existing evaluation-time assertion.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
